Dear stranger at the ferry terminal who gave my daughter your umbrella yesterday and then walked off into the rain before either of us could thank you: she has not stopped talking about it. She has decided that when she grows up she is going to carry two umbrellas everywhere, one for herself and one for whoever needs it, and I am not going to be the one to tell her how heavy that gets. Thank you, whoever you are.

Unpopular opinion: the best part of a long train journey is the hour after your phone dies and before you give in and ask somebody for a charger. You look out of the window properly for the first time in years. Yesterday it was two hours of fields, a heron, three abandoned stations and a man in a hi-vis jacket waving at the train as if he had been waiting all week for it to come past.
